name: Blue cheese
description: Cheese deliberately veined with mould and ripened for months.

tcm.note: Read with the aged cheeses; warming and damp-forming.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and very guru — aged, salty and mould-ripened.

histamine.note: Mould-ripened and long-aged — the highest cheese on the SIGHI list, above even hard cheddar.
